'''Ger Plortor''' was a scout for the [[Shad Furies/Legends|Shad Furies]] [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] team. While vacationing on [[Keedad]], Plortor discovered [[Ytavarg Aleema]] and convinced him to join the team.
